documents.title: Part B: Technical Description (Standard Action Project and Other Action Grants)

sub.label: 1.1 Background and general project objectives
prompts: Explain the problem and needs addressed. Describe the background, starting point and quantified baseline. Justify the project location and sector.

sub.label: 1.2 Specific project objectives
prompts: Describe specific, measurable, realistic and achievable objectives within the project duration.

sub.label: 1.3 Compliance with LIFE programme objectives and call topic
prompts: Explain contribution to LIFE Programme sub-programme (Nature and Biodiversity, Circular Economy and Quality of Life, Climate Change Mitigation and Adaptation or Clean Energy Transition) and call topic.

sub.label: 1.4 Concept and methodology
prompts: Describe overall intervention logic, main idea and assumptions. Explain methodology including tools, techniques, methods and procedures. Justify why proposed methodology is most suitable.

sub.label: 2.1 Ambition of the impacts
prompts: Identify and quantify effects of project during implementation and up to 5 years after project end. Use quantified indicators and targets.

sub.label: 2.2 Credibility of the impacts
prompts: Show calculation steps. Justify and substantiate baselines, benchmarks and assumptions using relevant publications, studies or statistics.

sub.label: 2.3 Sustainability of project results
prompts: Describe strategy to sustain project results after EU funding ends. Detail how project impact will be ensured and which resources are necessary.

sub.label: 2.4 Exploitation of project results
prompts: Describe ways of exploiting project results and identify targeted users.

sub.label: 2.5 Catalytic potential: Replication and upscaling
prompts: Describe potential for replication in same or other sectors. Identify factors favouring or limiting replication. Describe strategy to multiply project impact.

sub.label: 3.1 Work plan
prompts: Provide brief description of overall work plan structure including list of work packages or graphical presentation (Pert chart or similar).

sub.label: 3.2 Work packages and activities
prompts: Provide detailed description of project activities grouped into work packages. Include objectives, activities, milestones and deliverables for each package. Include mandatory work packages for project management and sustainability/replication/exploitation.

sub.label: 3.3 Stakeholder engagement
prompts: Identify key stakeholders outside consortium. Describe how you will mobilise them and secure their commitment via letters of support.

sub.label: 3.4 Impact monitoring and reporting
prompts: Describe overall approach to monitor and evaluate impact indicators. Include specific tasks in work plan to monitor, evaluate and report impacts.

sub.label: 3.5 Communication, dissemination and visibility
prompts: Define target audiences. Describe planned communication and dissemination activities to promote action and results. Describe methods and indicators to monitor outreach.

sub.label: 4.1 Consortium set-up
prompts: Describe consortium composition and how partners bring necessary expertise. Show valid role and adequate resources for each participant.

sub.label: 4.2 Project management
prompts: Describe management structures, decision-making mechanisms and communication procedures. Describe measures to ensure quality, monitoring, planning and control.

sub.label: 4.3 Green management
prompts: Describe measures to reduce environmental impact of project, for example through green procurement or environmental management systems.

sub.label: 4.4 Budget
prompts: See detailed budget table/calculator (annex 1 to Part B).

sub.label: 4.5 Risk management
prompts: Describe critical risks, uncertainties or difficulties. Indicate impact and likelihood for each risk. Describe mitigation measures.

sub.label: 5.1 Ethics
prompts: Not applicable for most LIFE projects.

sub.label: 5.2 Security
prompts: Not applicable for most LIFE projects.

sub.label: 6.1 Higher funding rate
prompts: Confirm if proposal fulfils conditions for higher funding rate (75% or 67%) for Nature and Biodiversity actions.

sub.label: 6.2 Double funding
prompts: Confirm no EU grants for this project (except EU Synergies actions). Confirm project not submitted for other EU funding.
